implemented_requirements.requirement: Support for three players and a landlord role
implemented_requirements.evidence: No code defining players, hands, or a landlord selection process is present.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Bidding phase to determine the landlord
implemented_requirements.evidence: The file contains only a Combination class; there is no bidding logic.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Representation and validation of all Dou Dizhu combinations (singles, pairs, straights, bombs, rockets, etc.)
implemented_requirements.evidence: class Combination with a KINDS placeholder and a beats() method that distinguishes rockets, bombs, and other kinds.
Combination.beats() implements comparison against a current combination, handling rockets, bombs, and same‑kind comparisons.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Win condition detection (first player to empty hand)
implemented_requirements.evidence: No game loop, hand management, or win‑check logic is present.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Full game flow (deal, bid, play, score)
implemented_requirements.evidence: Only a single utility class is provided; the overall flow is missing.

critical_issues: Missing core game components: deck creation, shuffling, dealing cards to three players.
No implementation of the bidding phase to select the landlord.
No player or hand management, turn order, or win‑condition detection.
Combination.KINDS is a placeholder ("{...}") and not defined, preventing runtime use.
No entry point or main game loop; the code cannot be executed as a playable game.
judge.summary: The repository only contains a skeletal Combination class that can compare two card combinations. It lacks any of the essential Dou Dizhu game mechanics such as player handling, bidding, dealing, turn management, and win detection. Consequently, the submission does not meet the benchmark requirements and is unlikely to run as a functional game.
